description: JAKARTA: Indonesia’s devastating wildfires are fueling anger across the country, with protesters demanding action against the toxic haze that has for weeks engulfed Southeast Asia, leaving hundreds of thousands of people ill. title: Turkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia sign defense cooperation accord, Ankara says
description: Turkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia have signed an agreement in Doha to enhance defense cooperation, known as the ‘Badr Memorandum of Understanding.’ This accord aims to strengthen their defensive capabilities and deepen partnerships.

title: Zelensky calls for freezing of front with Russia as first step to talks
description: President Zelensky of Ukraine has proposed freezing the current conflict frontlines with Russia as an initial step toward peace talks. This approach aims to establish a ceasefire in the ongoing war.

title: US Democratic congressional candidate Lander detained by Israeli authorities in West Bank
description: Brad Lander, a US Democratic congressional candidate, was detained by Israeli forces in the West Bank while volunteering. Rights groups confirm his detention among 90 volunteers.
